title: ChatBLAS: The First AI-Generated and Portable BLAS Library
problem: Can large language models generate portable BLAS libraries that are functionally correct and highly optimized across different CPU/GPU configurations? BLAS code requires device-specific optimizations, adding significant complexity to AI-assisted generation.
motivation: Automating the generation of portable, optimized HPC libraries through LLMs could reduce development effort and enable efficient implementations across diverse hardware platforms.
method: The authors use ChatGPT to generate C/C++ code for basic vector-math operations, specifically BLAS level-1 routines. The generated code is then optimized for different hardware—CPUs and GPUs—by applying hardware-specific optimizations. They verify that the code runs correctly and performs as well as or better than vendor-optimized BLAS libraries.
key_novelty: An AI language model can generate BLAS code that's functionally correct and performs as well as or better than vendor-optimized libraries across different CPU and GPU platforms.
contributions: First AI-generated portable BLAS library with functional correctness and competitive performance
Evaluation framework for LLM capabilities in generating optimized HPC code for heterogeneous hardware
Definition of best practices and criteria for trustworthy LLM-based HPC code generation
Evidence that AI-generated implementations can match or exceed vendor BLAS library performance

metrics.speedup: competitive with or better than vendor libraries

limitations: Work limited to vector-vector BLAS level-1 operations; scalability to higher-level BLAS operations and matrix dimensions not discussed.
